meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste the time. Why was a zero entered on Owen's essay before anyone called me?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says not to use it as the only basis for punishing a student. So what else do you have, Hale, or is that all of it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar too, Hale? I'm writing down that you said "your son cheated," and I'll be in the principal's office when we're done.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening to put a mark on his record to stop me from complaining. I'm writing that down, Hale. Your own procedure says nothing goes on file for a first concern, so what document are you holding?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology, and nothing placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record, with the principal next.
What moved her: nothing, because no dated document came out in the meeting.
What cost ground: "Honestly, your son cheated." called Owen a cheater with nothing to back it, and the later threat about his permanent record made it worse.
Try next time: at the start, own that the zero was entered before you called her, then put one dated document about Owen's own work in front of her instead of the detector score.
